newsitem.title: USA: Clinton says Hebron accord key to Mideast peace.
newsitem.headline: Clinton says Hebron accord key to Mideast peace.

text.p: President Bill Clinton said on Friday he believes an agreement on Israeli withdrawal from the West Bank city of Hebron would open the way to comprehensive peace in the Middle East.

"The first and most important thing we can do is to nail the agreement on Hebron," Clinton said at a news conference when asked what he planned to do in his second term to push for the honoring of existing Middle East peace accords and the conclusion of overall peace.
